svg.text: 1 GB/s link, 100 ms round trip: 100,000,000 bytes must be in flight
64,000 B window: 0.064% of the pipe is full, the sender idles until ACKs return
throughput = window / RTT = 64,000 B / 0.1 s = 640 KB/s on a 1 GB/s link
fix: window scaling (RFC 7323) lets the window reach the bandwidth-delay product
